review.finding: codex-models-probe.ts gated on result.ok instead of result.code === 0. readiness-probe-run.ts's shared parseExecResult ok heuristic (version-regex) would report ok:false for a real catalog with no dotted-version slug despite a clean exit and valid JSON.
review.suggestion: Fixed: gate on result.code === 0 (RunResult.code's own doc comment already documents this as the intended bypass), no change to the shared module or its other callers. Added a regression test (codex-models-probe.test.ts) with ok:false/code:0 and an all-integer-slug catalog.
